Episode 228. The Battle at Groshay Castle (13)
Kaahh-!

The Magic Sphere of Retrogradation was spinning, producing a sharp noise. The terrible noise and shockwaves overwhelmed the tinnitus caused by the Field of Oblivion, making everyone who was staggering within the ships and around the castle moan in response.
It felt like waking up from unconsciousness and feeling pain.
If it weren't for the shock of Retrogradation, the entire human forces would have experienced their consciousness being absorbed into the Field of Oblivion.
"Kuahh!"
The allied knights, the life-golems and mages of the Federation, the masters and demons of Kinzel, and the battle-beasts all struggled.
They did not know exactly what the magic Sakiel unfolded was, but they instinctively felt it was dangerous.
That's why they were struggling to not lose consciousness. Everyone gathered at Groshay Castle was aware that the moment they lose consciousness for even a moment, it would be over.
Also, the only reason they could keep their consciousness, even forcibly, was because Retrogradation was damaging Sakiel's magic.
In other words, the lives of everyone fighting at Groshay Castle were in Jin's hands.
"Kinzel! All forces, head under the sphere of Retrogradation as much as possible. Gather where Retrogradation's influence is strongest. If you're outside Retrogradation, it's over!"
Orgal shouted.
Thanks to his recently revived memories of the past, he understood exactly what kind of magic the Field of Oblivion was.

'It reveals how fundamentally flawed Jito's rule is. I can't believe she used the Field of Oblivion... If Jin Runkandel's Retrogradation can't properly block this, all the forces will suffer irreversible damage.'
Betty Ziple was also issuing a similar order.
"Endure under the sphere of Retrogradation. Humans and dragons move calmly beneath it. Demonic spirits can be used as shields as much as needed."
Demon spirits, life-golems, could be remade as much as needed even if they were lost here.
Until now, Retrogradation was always a symbol of terror for the allies, but now it was a lifeline.
Of course, Jin did not intend to perfectly protect them all.
They had just gathered in one place to repel a common enemy, they were not fundamentally allies, but clear enemies.
'Lucky them. I can't control Retrogradation at will while blocking Sakiel's magic, so even if they want to survive and come under Retrogradation, I can't drive them out.'
However, there was no reason to show consideration.
Retrogradation was a great magic that induced the backflow of magic in all living things within its range.
And those who were getting close to the Abyss now mostly possessed magic. All the demon clan members except for the masters and the beastmen in Kinzelo, and everyone in the Zipel Clan had magic.
"Urgh...!"
"Heck!"

All the enemies using the Abyss for survival had to pay the price. Those with less magic power than Jin, or a poorer understanding of magic, were all without exception experiencing a backlash of their magic power.
With every step closer to the Abyss, they couldn't help but cough up blood.
Of course, there were many in the Barmul Alliance who possessed magic. Even while countering the Field of Loss, Jin was adjusting the Abyss so that they wouldn't be harmed.
"It's too late to escape. The Barmul Alliance should gather in the Abyss, his magic already affects far beyond the walls of hell."
"Understood!"
Naturally, the Barmul Alliance occupied the safe zone of the Abyss first.

From time to time, members of other forces, half-crazed by the Abyss and the Field of Loss, tried to pose as part of the Alliance and aimed for the safe zone. All of them met their death by the swords of the Alliance's superhumans.
Once he confirmed that his allies had taken refuge under the Abyss, Jin started focusing on Sakiel again.
About three minutes had passed since the Field of Loss was deployed, during which Dante had been continuously attacking Sakiel.
Her body was already completely gone without a trace. The crystal sphere was shattered into pieces and scattered somewhere.
In the place where Sakiel stood, a purple aura that looked like smoke remained. It was her soul, spared from death thanks to Zito's real skill.
"Jin Runecandel... You're struggling until the end...!"
"That's my line, Sakiel. I don't know what it is, but it was quite an annoying magic."
Kiiit, Kaaaang-!
The Abyss was absorbing Sakiel's magic even more ferociously.
Not only the Field of Loss but also the Wall of Death was being torn down. The contracted Wall of Death was soon dismantled entirely by the Abyss, revealing the scenery outside the castle.
'I was aware that this magic is applied even outside the Wall of Death, but I didn't expect it to this extent...'
Above the sea soaked with blood and magic, a white mist-like aura was spreading endlessly. From the start, Sakiel had calculated that the army would flee from the Field of Loss.
Can the Abyss really absorb all that?
He couldn't immediately judge.
'The amount of magic power I have is not the problem. So, even if Enya brings the mirror she's using, it won't help.'
In Jin's assessment, what was needed now was not a means to amplify the Abyss, but a skilled person who could unravel the 'unknown dark ritual' as quickly as possible.
And Orgal had accurately predicted Jin's concerns.
"[Jin, this is a forbidden magic of the Demon Realm called the Field of Loss. I think I can help you. If you allow me to control the power of Reverse Heaven that's being applied on our side.]"
Jin smirked.
"Orgal, do you think I need you right now?"
[Hmm, I tried to prod you, but as expected, it's not working.]
"Be thankful for the fact that I'm keeping your forces safe. And be grateful for the fact that I'm not free enough to spill my unpleasant feelings toward Kinslow right now."
He implied that if Orgal acted up, he would throw him into the Reverse Heaven towards Kinslow. Orgal shrugged his shoulders and returned to his position.
[I can't even start a conversation because I'm scared. I was just trying to share good information.]
Jin didn't need to owe Orgal anything.
In the current alliance, there was someone who understood magic better than anyone else in the world.
"Jin."
Valeria Hester.
Jin smiled as he faced Valeria, who had flown to his side on the flow of Reverse Heaven. Valeria had been analyzing her magic as soon as Sakiel blew himself up.
"Valeria."

"Thanks to Orgal mentioning the name of the magic, I'm more certain. The structure of the spell and the magic circle were all new to me, so it was tough, but this magic is similar to Jipil's historical manipulation."
"Historical manipulation?"
"It would have an effect of damaging the target's memory. I was frustrated because I couldn't exactly understand the purpose of the magic, but the enemies were kind enough to blurt it out."
Orgal had told them the name of the magic was Field of Loss, and Sakiel had blabbed about the effect of it, which was 'to become an empty shell having forgotten everything'.
As soon as he heard Valeria's words, Jin quickly turned his head and looked back at Orgal.
'Orgal... From the start, you knew Valeria would step in and intentionally slipped the name of the magic. So Valeria could find a solution more easily.'
Orgal was smiling, with his thumb up.
From his perspective, it was beneficial for Jin to completely destroy the Field of Loss now. His offer to help was just a ploy to make Jin owe him a debt.
"Well, one of them had a slightly impure intention."

"Now that we know the name of the magic and its purpose, we just need to gradually unravel the complicated spell and array in reverse. You know? I'll take care of that, so keep blocking it so that the Field of Loss doesn't expand any further."
"Got it."

"Thanks to you messing up the moment the Field of Loss started, the spell has already largely collapsed. If it weren't for Reverse Heaven, I might not have been able to unravel it so quickly. It was really dangerous..."
Sakiel was speechless, in disbelief.
He had risked his life to deploy the top forbidden magic of the Demon Realm, and had even sacrificed countless demons, including himself, for it.
Jin was destroying the Field of Loss too easily. Even worse, Valeria Hester, a human, was analyzing and dismantling the magic circle as if she were studying.
'It's impossible... How dare these mere humans easily destroy the magic I've staked my life on...!'
A profound and immense sense of humiliation gnawed at the last vestiges of Sakielle's sanity.

The Field of Loss was crumbling before her eyes, and she was utterly powerless to respond. Her physical form that could further develop the magic had already disappeared, the sacrifices had disappeared, and the crystal sphere had disappeared.
All Sakielle could do was silently observe as Jin and Valeria dismantled the Field of Loss in her weakened soul state.
'Stop, I said stop!'
In the end, all Sakielle could do was scream.
Despite the fact that screaming revealed how badly she was cornered, and despite the fact that it only made her look more pathetic in the eyes of her enemies.
She simply couldn't cope with the shock of everything turning to ashes.

Looking back, it had always been this way from the moment she first faced Jin. The flesh of Gito always disappeared without a trace, the chosen numbers always missed, and no major magic could get through.
In other words, Sakielle was in despair.
"Be patient, it will be over soon. Do you guys go to hell when you die? Wherever you go, you should prepare to meet your king. Gito will also end soon."
'AAAAAAAHHHHH!'
Sakielle's scream echoed. She did not stop screaming until the Field of Loss was completely finished.
The agony and emptiness she felt now was comparable to, no, even more massive than what she had felt when she was tortured by Gito in the past.
'Lord Gito... I have failed to be of help to you and it ends like this. Unable to raise the flag of a new order. Paelito, do not forgive me.'
At that moment, Sakielle heard a voice mocking her.
It was Gito's voice, resonating from within her.
'Pffft, hahaha. Ah, I'm going crazy. Yes, that's it, Sakielle. This is exactly what I wanted. So, you don't have to feel sorry for me.'
'Lord Gito...!?'
'Ahahaha, you've worked hard. Don't worry about Paelito. I will play with him well.'
'Lord Gito, what the hell is this.'
'You're still addressing me with honorifics. Hey, Sakielle. Don't you remember something? Like a time when you and Paelito were very close.'
The brainwashing Gito had placed on Sakielle was coming undone. Memories she had forgotten came flooding back, and Sakielle was once again plunged into despair.
Just as she was about to curse Gito.
"It's over, Sakielle."
The Reverse Heaven completely shattered the Field of Loss. At the same time, Sakielle lost her last remaining consciousness.
It was the moment when the siege of Grosh Castle ended.
